name: zinterp_context_parse_bool_token
description: zInterp_Context::ParseBoolToken consumes the next token and returns true for case-insensitive on or true.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c19c0 validates NextToken consumption, null-token return of 0, and case-insensitive _stricmp checks against on and true.
The native smoke verifies ON and true return 1, off returns 0, and past-end token consumption returns 0.
